# HUD fixtures

`old-mod-reads-hud3.json` is what the main branch's released mod reader made of the current
`paqad.hud/3` snapshots. It is captured by bundling the main branch's
`runtime/claude-plugin/mod/model.ts` and `ship.ts` with esbuild and feeding them the mod test
fixtures (`FAST_ORD_490`, `GRADUATED_ORD_482`, `FULL_ORD_501`) plus one shipped snapshot with a push,
a pull request and a green CI reading, with every newer field filled in, and is never regenerated by
a test. It holds:

- `captured_from`: the main commit the reader came from.
- `inputs`: the `paqad.hud/3` snapshots it was given.
- `readings`: for each input, whether `parseSnapshot` threw, and what `buildBandView`, `isLive` and
  `shipRail` returned.

`tests/unit/plugin/mod/model.test.ts` checks that the old reader threw on none of them and that the
inputs still carry every top-level field today's snapshot has. When a new field joins the
snapshot, capture the file again the same way.
